_comment: Mirrors the live public.item_type_required_slots table (coordinator-dumped 2026-08-31, mint-ground-truth.md). Criterion 5 requires >=1 FACT or GAP claim per row whose claim_text contains the slot_key literally (case-insensitive substring). If this table changes live, re-dump and update this file.
_grade_note: Lane POP (2026-09-01, migration 278): this list IS 'the provenance minimum' -- it is UNCHANGED for grade='record'. The live public.item_type_required_slots table criterion 5 queries is keyed by item_type alone, with no grade column and no coordinator-side plan to add one; a record-grade item clears criterion 5 through the exact same per-item_type slot list a brief-grade item does (src/lib/intake/record-facts.mjs emits one FACT-or-GAP claim per slot here, honestly GAP when the captured text does not state it -- see that file's SLOT_TRIGGERS). There is no separate, smaller 'record slots' list to maintain, and inventing one would let a record item pass this local validator while failing the live DB gate on apply.
_intake_note: Lane INTAKE (2026-09-02, wave2 'build the tools before populating' ruling). Two kinds of change here. (1) BRAND NEW item_types 'notice'/'presidential_document' (Federal Register types HELD's export-census-rows.mjs holds item_type_unmapped today -- see this lane's report) carry the regulation family's four slots PLUS binding_position/due_date as REQUIRED: nothing existing depends on their slot count, so there is no fixture-breakage risk in adding them here. 'Proposed Rule' already maps onto the pre-existing 'initiative' item_type -- no change needed. (2) The five LONG-REGISTERED regulation-family item_types (regulation/directive/standard/guidance/framework) are DELIBERATELY left at their original four slots: hand-crafted fixture payloads outside this lane's write set (scripts/mint/validate-mint-payload.test.mjs's basePayload, scripts/mint/example-payload.json) assert an exact 4-claim/0-failure shape for 'directive', and this file feeds criterion 5 directly -- a 5th/6th REQUIRED slot here would fail those payloads' own tests without ever touching those coordinator-owned files. src/lib/intake/record-facts.mjs instead attaches binding_position/due_date to every regulation-family record payload (the five above PLUS the two new types) as an OPTIONAL, always-attempted addition keyed on item_type membership, independent of this file -- see that module's own header. market_signal/initiative gained corridor_identity and research_finding gained the two research-credibility slots as REQUIRED here since nothing in this repo hand-crafts a fixed claim list for those three item_types (grep-verified before this edit).
